Capture the following observations in TR: 1 ROHC is designed to fully exploit the traffic type and would need to be updated should a new type of internet header emerge. 2 Zlib is an abstraction of the DEFLATE algorithm where a header and trailer bytes are added to the raw DEFLATE data. 3 Zlib adds some extra overhead to the DEFLATE protocol, as header and trailer bytes are added to the raw DEFLATE data. 4 The possibility to manage the compression context memory as proposed in Adaptive Packet Data Compression could be expected to increase compression gain as packets with no or low level of redundancy could be excluded from the buffer.
